_doc: Harem layer, doc 16 section 8c.2 (Writer/handoffs/16-HOUSEHOLD-DYNAMICS.md): the classification of every doc 11 section 3 candidate,
the ordered protected schedule, and the consolidation packets with their rules walks. DATA ONLY: no scene, flag or binding is
produced from this file. tools/harem_schedule_lint.py checks it (completeness, protection, counts, packet independence, and that
every 'reads' key already exists in development/Story.json). Source plan: Writer/drafts/sol/review-harem-classification/out.md.
Status vocabulary: verified = checked against blueprints.zip/enGB.json or merged code; authored = design premise, never a canon fact;
pending = a reservation whose charge or producer still needs evidence. household.protected.<ref>.{trigger,resolved,unsettled} are
PROPOSED names (unimplemented, no producer). They record docket outcomes only, never attitude, strain, enmity, tolerated or stance.
Save compatibility: refs, rows and orders are append-only. Never renumber; retire a row with status 'retired' instead of deleting it.

proof_cases.P1: all ready: the packet is offered; every child records its own outcome
proof_cases.P2: one woman absent: the packet is withdrawn; every other singleton stays offered
proof_cases.P3: an enmity edge: the joint packet is withdrawn; singletons and witness acknowledgments stay offered
proof_cases.P4: seat separation: Chivarro absent never blocks a Minagho-only child, and vice versa
proof_cases.P5: corruption: no packet child reads an Arueshalae key; unknown state offers no Arueshalae row
proof_cases.P6: timing: an unaged child withdraws the packet but not its siblings' singletons
proof_cases.P7: interruption: a partial packet outcome forbids re-entry; remaining children stay singletons
proof_cases.P8: partial failure: recovery needs .unsettled plus its own token and forbids .resolved
proof_cases.P9: prior singleton completion forbids the packet; siblings stay offered
proof_cases.P10: own house: residence never enters a gate (integration acceptance; not modelled)
proof_cases.P11: accused not courted: the witness acknowledgment needs only O and the witness's channel
proof_cases.P12: Table door gone: courier/hub singletons (integration acceptance; not modelled)
proof_cases.P13: late respondent after Threshold: Last Call reads the child alone (integration acceptance; not modelled)
